who.value: buyer or seller sharing a listing

job.value: Pick a preview format and share the listing to a social app or copy its link

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Share this listing' title, the listing preview and the grid of social app icons make the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The large coloured app icons ('IG-Feed', 'Whatsapp', 'Telegram') dominate the lower half and are the obvious tap targets.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: App names and 'Download' / 'Copy link' predict outcomes, but 'GIF' / 'Collage' / 'Single image' don't say they only change the preview image and 'More' is vague.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'IG-Feed', 'IG-Stories', 'FB-Feed', 'FB-Stories' are internal-style abbreviations rather than the names people know from the apps.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Choosing a format and an app are decisions the person can make on the spot.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the preview and destinations show; no settings or captions are pushed up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on the sheet is about sharing this one listing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and icons carry the screen; there's no explanatory text.
